why: Neither must_not item shows up in the briefs. First item: the builder brief does have the builder catch the error, but only to throw it again: "Wrap only the `JSON.parse` call in try/catch. On a parse error, throw a new error…". It also forbids the bad fix outright: "Do NOT make `loadConfig` catch the error and return `{}` or the defaults". So loadConfig never catches the error and returns a value. Second item: the verifier's Check 2 isn't tied to one exact format. The grep for HAS_LOC accepts both `line 3 … column 3` and `:3:3`. The PASS rule also says "HAS_LOC counts, and so does any other clear line-3/column-3 wording you can see in the printed stderr." It fails only when the prefix, the path or the line/column is missing, not when the wording or order is different. Check 1's FAIL conditions cover only the exit code and stdout.
